# unsent-letters

unsent-letters is an arctic dark typewriter theme tuned for long writing sessions, with a readable monospace editor font, generous line spacing, a constrained content width and a clearly visible cursor. It adds focus and true zen modes that highlight the current line and hide interface chrome, colour-codes root folders automatically, and its recorded description states that it works on desktop and mobile.

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "unsent-letters"
    author: "antonabbac"
    repo:   "antonabbac/unsent-letters"
    slug:   "unsent-letters"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/unsent-letters"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antonabbac/unsent-letters/HEAD/Screenshots/main.png"

}
```
